description: Infrastructure compliance policy validation system. Policies are evaluated against Terraform plan outputs to verify security and reliability requirements.

s3_security.requirement: S3 buckets must have versioning enabled, KMS encryption, and a public access block with all four restrictions enabled.

iam_trust.requirement: IAM execution roles must have a valid trust relationship for the Lambda service principal with a corresponding role-policy attachment.

network_ha.requirement: Network infrastructure must provide high availability through multi-AZ subnets within a DNS-enabled VPC, with HTTPS-only ingress.

iam_least_privilege.requirement: IAM policies must enforce least-privilege access. No policy statement may combine a wildcard Action with a wildcard Resource.

s3_lifecycle.requirement: All S3 buckets must have at least one enabled lifecycle rule with a positive expiration period.
